reason: B adds a broader ER-to-mitochondria calcium transfer theme (MCU/SMDT1, release of sequestered Ca2+) and a mitochondrial dynamics/mitophagy theme (fission, fragmentation in apoptosis, PINK1-PRKN), covering the apoptosis and division facets the target's description names, at the cost of only mild calcium-theme redundancy.

A keeps the mid-level contexts B lacks, namely the SRP/ER cotranslational targeting, Golgi organization, mitochondrial/peroxisomal import and the 45-member Golgi-endosome trafficking theme; B jumps from small endosome/peroxisome themes straight to a 100-member secretory catch-all.

A gives a compact set of the key facets (intestinal HNF4/CDX absorptive-epithelium maturation, apical surface/CFTR and bile-lipid transport, pancreas, lung, branching), whereas B buries the same contexts under many near-duplicate glomerular and branching-morphogenesis themes and loses the apical lipid-transport theme.

B covers the same NPC facets (core pore/NPC reassembly, ribosome and protein transport, nuclear envelope breakdown/ESCRT resealing, mRNA export, SUMOylation) with about half as many themes, while A repeats nearly identical pore-plus-IP-transport themes many times over.

A is a clean nested ladder from resection/SSA through HR, DSB sensing/NHEJ choice, PARP/chromatin, Fanconi/crosslink repair up to all DNA repair; B adds many overlapping 35-135 member themes, and its extra mismatch-repair and telomere variants add clutter without sharpening the resection context.

A includes the epidermal lipid-barrier theme with fatty-acid transport, SLC27A4 ichthyosis prematurity syndrome and CYP4F22 ARCI5, which best explains an ABCA12 lipid-loading defect, plus hemidesmosome/junction contexts; B lacks that lipid-transport facet, although A has somewhat more redundant keratinocyte-differentiation themes.
